title: Name a number
summary: Go: Name a number. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: The := sign makes a new local variable and chooses its type from the value.

blocks.text: Install Go 1.22 or later. Save one complete example as lesson.go and run go run lesson.go.

blocks.title: Name a number

blocks.text: := declares pencils as 3. The sum is worked out before Println is called.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use = to change an existing variable; := declares a new one.
